name: The SPOK OS
title: THE SPOK OS
subtitle: An AI Operating System — soul made explicit, germline-sourced

versions.v0: First SPOK-native pass. 4 rings + 4 outcomes. Soul made explicit at the core; per-ring source tags (germline / local / rented). Generator-driven from this config.

lineage.inspiration: Ben AI 'THE AI OS' onion (AI Agent / Context / Connectors / Capabilities)
lineage.divergence: Ben collapses identity into the core and draws a single-org runtime view. SPOK makes SOUL explicit (4th outcome: 'carries your judgment') and tags each ring's SOURCE (the germline/warehouse view).

_ringNote: rings ordered OUTER -> INNER (drawing order). radius in px. fill = ring band. outcomeFill = matching right-side box (color is the visual mapping). accent=true gets the gold/star treatment.
designPrinciples: Concentric rings = layered architecture (inside-out dependency: capabilities need connectors need context need an agent)
Box color matches its ring — color IS the visual mapping, so arrows can stay simple
Soul is explicit at the core (Body + Soul), not collapsed into the agent
Each ring carries a SOURCE tag — the runtime onion overlaid with the germline/warehouse view
Model lives in config.json; SVG is a disposable projection — edit data, never the picture
graduation: Canonical model graduates to the SPOK germline (~/SPOK) when spok.os packages. Prototype lives here in systems-thinking-labs.
